spans.s: (I)--one of the ten horses of the moon's chariot. Br. II. २३. ५६; M. १२६. ५२; वा. ५२. ५३.
(III)--one of the three sons of शतजित् (शतजि- म्। प्।). Br. III. ६९. 4; M. ४३. 8; वा. ९४. 4.

(I)--(हयशीर्ष)--a manifestation of Hari worshipped as such by भद्रश्रवस्: Half-man and half- horse: got back to ब्रह्मा the Vedas seized by Asura Madhu of रसातल;
1: भा. V. १
(II)--a son of Danu: followed वृत्र in his battles with Indra: a follower of Bali. ^1 भा.
(III)--the demon who carried off the Vedas during the pralaya: killed by Matsya Hari who recovered them. भा. VIII. २४. 8 and ५७.
(V)--an Asura killed by कृष्ण in प्राग्ज्योतिष. Vi. V. २९. १९.
(I)--a daughter of वैश्वानर and wife of Kratu. भा.
(II)--a sacred तीर्थ for श्राद्ध. Br. III. १३. ४६; वा. ७७. ४६.
--an अवतार् of विष्णु, who appeared in the sacrifice of ब्रह्मा. भा.
--the science of medicine relating to horses. M. १५. २०.
